title: Note — rasa.module.notes (records-family/1)
description: A note: one file under notes/<notebook>/, titled by its H1. The notebook is the directory the file sits in; there is no notebook key. Field law for the frontmatter; cross-record law (notebooks, links, history) is in .claude/notes-rules.md.

updated.description: Bumped by every tool edit; `notes touch` after a hand edit.

type.description: What kind of note (meeting, journal, idea, reference, ...). Declare to constrain: config `types`.

tags.description: Many-to-many labels. Declare to constrain: config `tags`.

pinned.description: Only ever `true`; an unpinned note omits the key.

about.description: What the note is about: any family record (CARD-, EVT-, THR-, LEAD-, acct-, NOTE-, TASK-...).

source.x-anyOf-message: must be a URI (https://..., file:...) or a family id
